question: What are all the distinct malware variant names mentioned across these reports?
answer:
- Fog ransomware
- GC2 implant
- Stowaway
- Syteca (formerly Ekran) employee-monitoring software
- Adaptix C2 Agent Beacon
- Impacket (post-exploitation utilities)
- cwiper.exe (ransomware loader)
- ktool.exe (privilege-escalation exploit)
- Win32.FOG.SMYPEFG (FOG ransomware family detection)
- .flocked binaries (embedded payloads)
- stage1.ps1 (multi-stage PowerShell script)
